desc: Start-to-join: player 1 on a controller in port 1, a second controller plugged in (SDL puts it in port 2) and pressed (A, B: nothing joins, even with Co-op (up to 4 players) on as by default), then its Start: only that makes it player 2 (2P joined, two playing), and its buttons then play the partner. Shot: joined (the 2P tag over the partner)
log_must: \[seats\] 540: port 1 pad 1, port 2 pad 2; player 2 nobody; 1 playing
\[seats\] 650: port 1 pad 1, port 2 pad 2; player 2 nobody; 1 playing
\[seats\] 780: port 1 pad 1, port 2 pad 2; player 2 plays; 2 playing
